transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to get next week's sustainment-training board finalized and published by 1600 today. Before I sign it, I need the S-3 and motor pool chief to report any schedule or readiness changes at our weekly training huddle now. Specifically, I need to confirm: are all six training trucks released and available for the standard driver-certification block on Tuesday morning, and are there any issues with the radio-procedures refresher for support personnel? Let's hear from the S-3 first.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a schedule change. I received a higher-headquarters tasking this morning requiring 2nd Platoon to complete a radio-procedures refresher on Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, with an attendance roster submitted afterward. This tasking is still being entered into the battalion training tracker and is not yet on the briefing slide, so it won't be visible to anyone else yet. This may affect how we sequence the radio-procedures refresher for support personnel on the board.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report a readiness change regarding the training trucks. During this morning's inspection, I confirmed that only four of the six assigned training trucks have completed brake inspections. The other two trucks will not be released until Friday at 0800, and their inspection status has not yet been posted to the training board. Those two trucks must remain on hold until their inspections are complete. This means we will not have all six trucks available for the standard driver-certification block on Tuesday morning.
transcript.speaker: A3
